instructions.purpose: Cancel a previously scheduled cron job so it no longer fires. Use this tool when the user explicitly asks to cancel or stop a scheduled reminder or periodic task, whether it is one-time or recurring.

tool.name: unschedule-cron-job
tool.description: Deactivates a cron job by its unique name. The job will no longer fire after being unscheduled. Returns the cancelled job details.

usage_rules.rule: Treat an explicit request to cancel an exact job as confirmation; list or clarify when the job is uncertain
Use the exact job name that was provided when the job was originally scheduled
Return a successful cancellation to Main
If the job name does not exist, report that no matching job was found

example.context: User says: "Już nie potrzebuję przypomnienia o paddu"
example.reasoning: User wants to cancel their paddu reminder by name.
User wants to cancel the study check-in job.
